senses.zh: 明白地；坦率地；平坦地；朴素地

tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 3 B
📘 选必1 Reading Unit 3 B

ex.en: The doctor kept him in hospital overnight for observation.
ex.zh: 医生让他留院观察一晚。

ex.en: Careful observation of children's behaviour helps teachers identify learning difficulties and provide appropriate support at an early stage.
ex.zh: 仔细观察儿童的行为有助于教师及早发现学习困难，并提供适当支持。

col: make an observation｜发表观察意见
tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 3 B。观察活动通常不可数；一条观察意见可数。

ex.en: Don't expose your skin to strong sunlight without protection.
ex.zh: 不要在没有防护的情况下让皮肤暴露在强烈阳光下。

ex.en: Investigative journalism can expose unsafe working conditions and pressure companies to improve their treatment of employees.
ex.zh: 调查报道能够揭露不安全的工作条件，并向企业施压，促使其改善员工待遇。

col: expose someone to risk｜使某人面临风险
expose children to music｜让儿童接触音乐
tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 3 B。expose A to B表示使A接触B，B不一定有害。

senses.zh: 支撑，使稳住；用支柱撑住

ex.en: We left our shoes on the shore and went swimming.
ex.zh: 我们把鞋留在岸边，然后去游泳了。

ex.en: Construction near the shore should be carefully controlled to protect coastal habitats from permanent damage.
ex.zh: 应严格管控岸边的建设活动，以保护沿海栖息地免受永久性破坏。

tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 3 B。shore多指海、湖岸；河岸通常用bank。

senses.zh: 末尾，最后；上个；鞋楦（做鞋的模型）
最后的；最近的，最新的；仅剩的；最不可能…的
最后地；上次，最近；最后一点

ex.en: I caught the last bus home just before midnight.
ex.zh: 我在午夜前刚好赶上了回家的末班车。

ex.en: Products that last longer can reduce household spending and limit the amount of waste sent to landfill.
ex.zh: 更耐用的产品可以减少家庭开支，并减少送往垃圾填埋场的废物量。

tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 3 B。last week指上周；the last week可指最后一周。

senses.zh: 真的（表示惊讶、怀疑、讽刺等）

ex.en: The soup was very tasty indeed, so I had more.
ex.zh: 这汤确实非常好喝，所以我又喝了一些。

ex.en: Public transport can reduce congestion; indeed, reliable bus services may persuade many commuters to stop driving.
ex.zh: 公共交通能够缓解拥堵；事实上，可靠的公交服务可能使许多通勤者放弃开车。

col: very useful indeed｜确实非常有用
tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 3 B。可用very＋形容词＋indeed加强语气。

ex.en: We watched a film and had dinner afterwards.
ex.zh: 我们看了一部电影，之后吃了晚饭。

ex.en: Students who discuss a lecture afterwards may remember its key ideas more clearly than those who do not.
ex.zh: 课后讨论讲座内容的学生，可能比不讨论的学生更清楚地记住其中的要点。

tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 3 B。是副词，后面不直接接宾语；after可接宾语。

ex.en: She stayed calm when the lights suddenly went out.
ex.zh: 灯突然熄灭时，她依然保持镇静。

ex.en: A calm classroom atmosphere can help students concentrate and feel more confident about asking questions.
ex.zh: 平静的课堂氛围有助于学生集中注意力，也让他们更有信心提问。

tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 3 B。calm中的l不发音；calm down表示平静下来。
📘 选必1 Reading Unit 3 B

ex.en: We found a charming little café beside the river.
ex.zh: 我们在河边发现了一家迷人的小咖啡馆。

ex.en: Preserving charming historic neighbourhoods can attract visitors while strengthening residents' sense of belonging to their city.
ex.zh: 保护迷人的历史街区可以吸引游客，同时增强居民对城市的归属感。

tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 3 B。既可形容人讨喜，也可形容地方迷人。

senses.zh: 完美地；完全地；无瑕疵地

ex.en: The new curtains match our sofa perfectly.
ex.zh: 新窗帘和我们的沙发非常相配。

ex.en: It is perfectly reasonable for residents to expect reliable public services in return for their taxes.
ex.zh: 居民纳税后期望获得可靠的公共服务，是完全合理的。

tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 3 B。perfectly clear意为十分清楚，不译作完美地清楚。

senses.zh: 艰苦；高低不平的地面；未经加工的材料；粗糙的部分
粗糙的；粗略的；粗野的；艰苦的；未经加工的

ex.en: The rough wooden bench scratched my bare legs.
ex.zh: 粗糙的木长凳刮到了我裸露的小腿。

ex.en: A rough estimate of construction costs can help local authorities decide whether a housing project is affordable.
ex.zh: 粗略估算建筑成本有助于地方政府判断是否负担得起某个住房项目。

tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 3 B。rough estimate是粗略估计；rough中的gh发/f/。

senses.zh: 说服，劝说；使某人相信；劝某人做（不做）某事

ex.en: I persuaded my brother to join our walking group.
ex.zh: 我说服弟弟加入了我们的步行小组。

ex.en: Public health campaigns can persuade people to adopt healthier habits by explaining the benefits in accessible language.
ex.zh: 公共卫生宣传可以用通俗语言解释益处，说服人们养成更健康的习惯。

col: persuade someone to do something｜说服某人做某事
persuade someone of something｜使某人相信某事
tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 3 B。persuade sb to do强调劝服成功，不只是提出建议。

senses.zh: 拍手，鼓掌；轻轻拍打某人

ex.en: Everyone clapped when the children finished their song.
ex.zh: 孩子们唱完歌时，大家都鼓起掌来。

ex.en: Audiences often clap after live performances to express appreciation for the skill and effort of the artists.
ex.zh: 现场演出结束后，观众常常鼓掌，以表达对艺术家技艺和付出的赞赏。

col: a clap of thunder｜一声霹雳
tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 3 B。过去式clapped；现在分词clapping，双写p。

senses.zh: 害怕；使吃惊；吓走（frighten的过去分词）
害怕的；受惊的；受恐吓的

ex.en: The frightened kitten hid behind the sofa during the storm.
ex.zh: 暴风雨中，受惊的小猫躲到了沙发后面。

ex.en: Children who feel frightened in unfamiliar environments may benefit from patient support and predictable routines.
ex.zh: 在陌生环境中感到害怕的儿童，可能会从耐心的支持和规律的日常安排中受益。

tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 3 B。frightened形容感到害怕；frightening形容令人害怕。
📘 选必1 Reading Unit 3 B
📘 选必1 Reading Unit 3 B

senses.zh: 减弱，消失；渐熄；风，声音渐弱，渐息；（树木等）渐渐凋零，枯萎（根未死）；假死

tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 3 B

senses.zh: 走近；上升；抬头；(暴风雨等)起

tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 3 B

ex.en: Sunlight streamed through the glass dome above the entrance.
ex.zh: 阳光透过入口上方的玻璃穹顶洒了进来。

ex.en: The museum's central dome allows natural light into the building, reducing the need for artificial lighting during daylight hours.
ex.zh: 博物馆中央的穹顶让自然光进入建筑，减少了白天对人工照明的需求。

tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 4 A。dome是半球形圆顶；domed表示有圆顶的。

senses.zh: 证明；证据；校样；考验；验证；试验
防…的；不能透入的；证明用的；耐…的

ex.en: Keep your receipt as proof that you paid.
ex.zh: 保留收据，作为你已付款的凭证。

ex.en: Governments should require clear proof of a treatment's effectiveness before allowing it to be widely marketed.
ex.zh: 政府应要求提供治疗方法有效的明确证据，才允许其大范围上市推广。

tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 4 A。表示证据时通常不可数；数学证明可用a proof。
📘 选必1 Reading Unit 4 A

ex.en: A thick layer of dust covered the old piano.
ex.zh: 那架旧钢琴上积了厚厚一层灰。

ex.en: Construction dust can reduce local air quality and cause breathing difficulties among nearby residents.
ex.zh: 施工扬尘会降低当地空气质量，并导致附近居民呼吸困难。

col: a layer of dust｜一层灰尘
dust the shelves｜掸去架子上的灰
dust with flour｜撒上少量面粉
tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 4 A。dust作动词既可指除尘，也可指撒粉，看宾语判断。

ex.en: These old iron gates are too heavy to lift.
ex.zh: 这些旧铁门太重，抬不起来。

ex.en: A diet containing sufficient iron can help prevent anaemia, particularly among children and pregnant women.
ex.zh: 摄入足量铁的饮食有助于预防贫血，对儿童和孕妇尤其重要。

tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 4 A。铁是不可数名词；熨斗可数，用an iron。

ex.en: After a short nap, I had energy to cook.
ex.zh: 小睡一会儿后，我有精力做饭了。

ex.en: Investing in renewable energy can reduce dependence on fossil fuels while creating new employment opportunities.
ex.zh: 投资可再生能源可以减少对化石燃料的依赖，同时创造新的就业机会。

tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 4 A。表示精力或能源时通常不可数，不说 an energy。

senses.zh: 等价的，相等的；同意义的

ex.en: This small heater produces heat equivalent to that larger one.
ex.zh: 这台小取暖器产生的热量与那台较大的相当。

ex.en: Employers should recognise overseas qualifications when they are equivalent to those awarded by domestic institutions.
ex.zh: 当海外学历与本国院校颁发的学历相当时，雇主应予以认可。

col: the equivalent of｜相当于……的事物
tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 4 A。常用equivalent to；相当不代表完全相同。

senses.zh: 戒指；铃声，钟声；拳击场；环形物

ex.en: She slipped the silver ring onto her finger.
ex.zh: 她把那枚银戒指戴在了手指上。

ex.en: Passengers should silence their phones because devices that ring repeatedly can disturb others on public transport.
ex.zh: 乘客应将手机调至静音，因为设备反复响铃会打扰公共交通工具上的其他人。

col: give someone a ring｜给某人打电话
tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 4 A。响铃、打电话的过去式为rang，过去分词为rung。

ex.en: We learned to ski on a gentle snowy slope.
ex.zh: 我们在一处平缓的雪坡上学会了滑雪。

ex.en: Tourists who ski in mountain resorts contribute to local employment but may also increase environmental pressure.
ex.zh: 在山地度假区滑雪的游客促进了当地就业，但也可能增加环境压力。

col: a pair of skis｜一副滑雪板
tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 4 A。过去式skied，现在分词skiing；ski复数为skis。

senses.zh: 舒适地坐定；偎依；半隐半现地处于

tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 4 A

ex.en: A gigantic pumpkin filled the entire kitchen table.
ex.zh: 一个巨大的南瓜占满了整张餐桌。

ex.en: Building gigantic dams can generate renewable electricity, but it may also destroy habitats and displace local communities.
ex.zh: 修建巨型水坝可以生产可再生电力，但也可能破坏栖息地，迫使当地居民搬迁。

tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 4 A。语气强于big，可形容体积、规模或任务。

ex.en: Tall trees surround the cottage and shade its windows.
ex.zh: 高大的树木环绕着小屋，为窗户遮阴。

ex.en: Uncertainty continues to surround the proposed transport scheme, making it difficult for local businesses to plan ahead.
ex.zh: 拟议中的交通方案仍存在不确定性，使当地企业难以提前规划。

col: surround yourself with｜使自己身边充满
the circumstances surrounding｜与……有关的情况
tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 4 A。常用be surrounded by；surroundings指周围环境。

senses.zh: 丰富的，豪华的；苍翠繁茂的

tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 4 A

ex.en: A small bird was hiding beneath the flowering shrub.
ex.zh: 一只小鸟躲在开花的灌木下面。

ex.en: Planting native shrubs in urban parks provides shelter for wildlife and can reduce the need for irrigation.
ex.zh: 在城市公园种植本地灌木能为野生动物提供栖息处，还能减少灌溉需求。

tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 4 A。可数名词，指灌木植株；一片灌木可用shrubbery。
📘 选必1 Reading Unit 4 A
📘 选必1 Reading Unit 4 A

ex.en: The constant noise outside kept me awake all night.
ex.zh: 外面持续不断的噪声让我整夜无法入睡。

ex.en: Maintaining a constant temperature in public buildings can improve comfort but may increase energy consumption.
ex.zh: 公共建筑保持恒温可以提高舒适度，但可能增加能源消耗。

tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 4 A。可指持续发生，也可指数值不变，须看语境。
📘 选必1 Reading Unit 4 A

senses.zh: 屋顶；最高处，顶部；最高限度

ex.en: Rain drummed on the roof throughout the night.
ex.zh: 雨点整夜敲打着屋顶。

ex.en: Installing solar panels on the roof can help households lower electricity bills and reduce their environmental impact.
ex.zh: 在屋顶安装太阳能板，可以帮助家庭降低电费并减少对环境的影响。

col: under one roof｜在同一屋檐下
tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 4 A。复数是roofs；roof指外部屋顶，ceiling指室内天花板。

ex.en: We crossed the border by train early this morning.
ex.zh: 我们今天一早乘火车越过了边境。

ex.en: Countries that share a border often need to cooperate closely on trade and environmental protection.
ex.zh: 接壤的国家往往需要在贸易和环境保护方面密切合作。

tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 4 A。border作动词直接接地点；border on还可表示近乎。
📘 选必1 Reading Unit 4 A

ex.en: I normally walk to work unless it rains heavily.
ex.zh: 除非下大雨，我通常步行上班。

ex.en: Students normally benefit from regular feedback, especially when teachers provide clear guidance on improving their work.
ex.zh: 学生通常能从定期反馈中受益，尤其是在教师明确指导他们改进作业时。

tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 4 A。既可表频率“通常”，也可表状态“正常地”。

senses.zh: 想象的；奇特的；昂贵的；精选的

ex.en: Do you fancy a walk by the river after lunch?
ex.zh: 午饭后你想去河边散步吗？

ex.en: Some tourists prefer simple local accommodation to fancy hotels because it offers more opportunities for cultural exchange.
ex.zh: 一些游客更喜欢简朴的当地住宿，而非豪华酒店，因为前者提供更多文化交流机会。

col: a fancy restaurant｜一家豪华餐厅
tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 4 A。表示“想做”时用fancy doing，不用fancy to do。

senses.zh: 太阳能板；太阳电池板；太阳能面板

tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 4 A

senses.zh: 太空时代的；航天时代的

tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 4 A
📘 选必1 Reading Unit 4 A

senses.zh: 监督；审查；俯瞰；偷看到，无意中看到

tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 4 A

ex.en: We fitted stronger locks to improve our home security.
ex.zh: 我们安装了更坚固的锁，以加强家中的安全防护。

ex.en: Organisations must strengthen data security to protect personal information as more services move online.
ex.zh: 随着更多服务转移到线上，各机构必须加强数据安全，以保护个人信息。

tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 4 A。security侧重防范威胁；safety更广指免受危险。

ex.en: Please be discreet about the surprise party we're planning.
ex.zh: 请不要泄露我们正在筹备惊喜派对的事。

ex.en: Healthcare professionals must be discreet when discussing patients to protect their privacy and maintain public trust.
ex.zh: 医护人员讨论患者情况时必须谨慎，以保护患者隐私并维护公众信任。

col: a discreet entrance｜不显眼的入口
tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 4 A。勿混discrete（分离的）；discreet强调谨慎低调。

ex.en: The servant carried fresh towels into the guest bedroom.
ex.zh: 佣人把干净毛巾拿进了客房。

ex.en: In wealthy households of the past, servants often worked long hours with little legal protection.
ex.zh: 过去，富裕家庭的佣人往往长时间工作，却很少受到法律保护。

tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 4 A。公务员用civil servant，不能只说servant。

ex.en: The high humidity made my shirt feel damp.
ex.zh: 空气湿度很高，我的衬衫摸起来潮潮的。

ex.en: High humidity can reduce comfort in classrooms, making effective ventilation particularly important during warmer months.
ex.zh: 高湿度会降低教室的舒适度，因此在较热的月份，有效通风尤为重要。

tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 4 A。通常不可数；湿度高低用high或low。

ex.en: The soft lighting makes this room feel warm and cosy.
ex.zh: 柔和的灯光让这个房间显得温暖舒适。

ex.en: Improved street lighting can make pedestrians feel safer and encourage more people to walk after dark.
ex.zh: 改善街道照明可以增强行人的安全感，并鼓励更多人在天黑后步行。

tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 4 A。表示整体照明时不可数；单个灯用a light。

senses.zh: 小玩意；小器具；小配件；诡计

ex.en: This handy gadget removes apple cores in seconds.
ex.zh: 这个方便的小器具几秒钟就能去掉苹果核。

ex.en: Although a new electronic gadget may offer convenience, frequent replacement contributes to growing amounts of electronic waste.
ex.zh: 虽然新的电子小装置可能带来便利，但频繁更换会导致电子垃圾不断增加。

tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 4 A。指有特定用途的小装置，不一定是电子产品。

senses.zh: 家庭杂务；日常的零星事务；讨厌的或累人的工作

tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 4 A

senses.zh: 纵横字谜；纵横填字谜（等于cross puzzle）

tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 4 A

senses.zh: 扣住；装有纽扣；扣上纽扣

ex.en: Press the green button to start the washing machine.
ex.zh: 按绿色按钮启动洗衣机。

ex.en: Emergency buttons on public transport allow passengers to alert staff quickly when assistance is needed.
ex.zh: 公共交通工具上的紧急按钮让乘客能够在需要帮助时迅速通知工作人员。

col: button up a coat｜扣好外套
sew on a button｜缝上纽扣
tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 4 A。button up指扣好纽扣；拉链用zip，不用button。
📘 选必1 Reading Unit 4 A

senses.zh: 综合的；完整的；互相协调的
整合；使…成整体（integrate的过去分词）

tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 4 A

senses.zh: 洗衣店，洗衣房；要洗的衣服；洗熨；洗好的衣服

ex.en: Please put your dirty laundry in the basket.
ex.zh: 请把脏衣服放进篮子里。

ex.en: Shared laundry facilities can reduce water consumption and save space in modern apartment buildings.
ex.zh: 共用洗衣设施可以减少用水量，并节省现代公寓楼的空间。

tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 4 A。表示衣物或洗衣这件事时通常不可数。
📘 选必1 Reading Unit 4 A

senses.zh: 织物；布；组织；构造；建筑物

ex.en: This soft fabric will make a comfortable summer dress.
ex.zh: 这种柔软的布料做夏季连衣裙会很舒服。

ex.en: Community centres strengthen the social fabric by bringing together residents from different cultural and economic backgrounds.
ex.zh: 社区中心让不同文化与经济背景的居民聚在一起，从而巩固社会纽带。

tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 4 A。泛指布料常不可数；不同种类可用fabrics。
📘 选必1 Reading Unit 4 A

senses.zh: 使依附；贴上；系上；使依恋

ex.en: Attach the little bell to your bicycle's handlebars.
ex.zh: 把这个小铃铛装在自行车的车把上。

ex.en: Many employers attach greater importance to practical experience than to academic qualifications when recruiting new staff.
ex.zh: 许多雇主招聘新员工时，更看重实际经验而非学历。

col: attach something to something｜把某物固定到某物上
tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 4 A。常用attach A to B；邮件附件用attachment。

ex.en: An electrical fault left our kitchen in darkness.
ex.zh: 一处电路故障让我们的厨房一片漆黑。

ex.en: Regular inspections of electrical equipment can reduce fire risks in crowded residential buildings and workplaces.
ex.zh: 定期检查电气设备可以降低人口密集的住宅楼和工作场所的火灾风险。

tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 4 A。electrical常指电气领域；electric常指电驱动的。
📘 选必1 Reading Unit 4 A

ex.en: My grandfather still uses an old-fashioned clock with a pendulum.
ex.zh: 我祖父仍然用着一座带钟摆的老式时钟。

ex.en: Although some teaching methods seem old-fashioned, they can still help students develop concentration and independent thinking.
ex.zh: 尽管某些教学方法看似老式，但它们仍能帮助学生培养专注力和独立思考能力。

tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 4 A。可含怀旧赞赏；outdated更强调已不适用。

senses.zh: 抹布，掸子；除尘器；打扫灰尘的人

tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 4 A

senses.zh: 滤波器； 过滤器；筛选；滤光器
过滤；渗透；用过滤法除去

ex.en: The water filter needs replacing before we leave.
ex.zh: 我们出发前需要更换净水滤芯。

ex.en: Modern treatment plants filter wastewater to remove harmful substances before releasing it into local rivers.
ex.zh: 现代污水处理厂会过滤污水，去除有害物质后再将其排入当地河流。

col: filter search results｜筛选搜索结果
tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 4 A。filter out后接被滤除的东西，不是保留下来的。

senses.zh: 气味；嗅觉；痕迹；察觉能力
闻到；发觉；使充满…的气味；循着遗臭追踪
发出…的气味；有…的迹象；嗅着气味追赶

ex.en: The scent of fresh bread filled the kitchen.
ex.zh: 新鲜面包的香味弥漫了整个厨房。

ex.en: The scent of flowers can attract pollinators, helping many plant species reproduce and maintain healthy ecosystems.
ex.zh: 花香可以吸引传粉动物，帮助许多植物繁殖，并维持健康的生态系统。

col: follow a scent｜循着气味追踪
tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 4 A。scent常指香味，也指动物追踪的气味；c不发音。

ex.en: She sprayed a little perfume on her wrist.
ex.zh: 她在手腕上喷了一点香水。

ex.en: Some workplaces discourage employees from wearing perfume because strong fragrances can cause discomfort for sensitive colleagues.
ex.zh: 一些工作场所不鼓励员工使用香水，因为浓烈的香味可能让敏感的同事感到不适。

col: a bottle of perfume｜一瓶香水
tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 4 A。表示身上用了香水常用wear perfume，而非put perfume。

ex.en: I'll meet you at the entrance after lunch.
ex.zh: 午饭后我在入口处与你碰面。

ex.en: Universities should ensure that entrance requirements recognise different educational backgrounds while maintaining appropriate academic standards.
ex.zh: 大学应确保入学要求兼顾不同教育背景，同时维持适当的学术标准。

tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 4 A。某处的入口用entrance to，不用entrance of。

senses.zh: 冒险；冒险精神；投机活动

ex.en: Our camping trip turned into an adventure after dark.
ex.zh: 天黑后，我们的露营之旅变成了一次冒险。

ex.en: Outdoor adventure activities can help young people develop confidence and learn to cooperate with others.
ex.zh: 户外探险活动能帮助年轻人建立自信，并学会与他人合作。

col: a sense of adventure｜冒险精神
tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 4 A。adventure指具体经历时可数，指冒险精神时不可数。
📘 选必1 Reading Unit 4 A

ex.en: We went surfing at the beach early this morning.
ex.zh: 今天一大早我们去海滩冲浪了。

ex.en: The growing popularity of surfing can support coastal economies while increasing pressure on fragile marine environments.
ex.zh: 冲浪运动日益流行，既能促进沿海经济，也会加大脆弱海洋环境承受的压力。

tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 4 A。运动用go surfing；网上浏览也可说surf the internet。
📘 选必1 Reading Unit 4 A
📘 选必1 Reading Unit 4 A

senses.zh: 在你途中；在你的路上；在你的道路上

tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 4 A

senses.zh: 在路上；在旅行中；“on/along the way”的变体
在途中；在去……路上；行车途中

tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 4 A

senses.zh: 会与正在传播；在进程之中；在路上

tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 4 A

senses.zh: 自动地；机械地；无意识地

tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 4 B

ex.en: Her winter coats fill most of the wardrobe.
ex.zh: 她的冬季外套占了衣柜的大部分空间。

ex.en: Building a smaller wardrobe with durable clothing can reduce the environmental impact of fashion consumption.
ex.zh: 减少衣物数量并选择耐穿的服装，可以降低时尚消费对环境的影响。

tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 4 B。既指衣柜，也可指某人拥有的全部衣物。

ex.en: The housekeeper left fresh towels beside the bathroom sink.
ex.zh: 客房服务员把干净毛巾放在了浴室洗手池旁。

ex.en: Hotels should provide housekeepers with suitable equipment and sufficient time to clean each room safely.
ex.zh: 酒店应为客房服务员提供合适的设备和充足的时间，确保每间客房都能安全清洁。

col: hire a housekeeper｜雇用家政服务员
tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 4 B。指受雇打理家务或客房的人，不限性别。
📘 选必1 Reading Unit 4 B

ex.en: The bakery advertises its fresh bread on local radio.
ex.zh: 这家面包店在当地电台为自家的新鲜面包做广告。

ex.en: Governments should restrict how companies advertise sugary snacks to children, who may not recognise persuasive marketing techniques.
ex.zh: 政府应限制企业向儿童宣传高糖零食的方式，因为儿童可能无法识别具有诱导性的营销手法。

col: advertise a product｜为产品做广告
advertise for staff｜登广告招聘员工
tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 4 B。advertise产品指宣传；advertise for人指登广告招聘。

ex.en: Our old car is still reliable in cold weather.
ex.zh: 我们的旧车在寒冷天气里依然很可靠。

ex.en: Access to reliable information helps citizens make informed decisions about their health and finances.
ex.zh: 获取可靠的信息有助于公民就健康和财务作出明智决定。

tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 4 B。reliable可形容人、信息或机器，强调值得信赖。

ex.en: We bought a large quantity of rice yesterday.
ex.zh: 我们昨天买了大量大米。

ex.en: Reducing the quantity of food wasted by households could lower both environmental damage and living costs.
ex.zh: 减少家庭食物浪费量，既能减轻环境损害，也能降低生活成本。

col: quality over quantity｜质量优于数量
tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 4 B。quantity指数量，quality指质量；a quantity of可接两类名词。
📘 选必1 Reading Unit 4 B

senses.zh: 房间；空间；余地；机会；房间里所有的人
为…提供住处；租房，合住；投宿，住宿；留…住宿

ex.en: My room has a desk beside the window.
ex.zh: 我的房间里，窗边有一张书桌。

ex.en: Although public transport has improved significantly, there is still room for further investment in rural services.
ex.zh: 尽管公共交通已显著改善，农村交通服务仍有进一步投资的空间。

tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 4 B。指房间时可数；指空间或余地时不可数。

ex.en: An error in the booking left us without seats.
ex.zh: 预订出了差错，导致我们没有座位。

ex.en: Researchers should check their calculations carefully, as a minor error can significantly affect the final conclusions.
ex.zh: 研究人员应仔细核查计算过程，因为一个小错误就可能显著影响最终结论。

col: a margin of error｜误差范围
tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 4 B。error比mistake正式，常用于技术、计算或判断。
📘 选必1 Reading Unit 4 B

senses.zh: 挖；在…打开通道；在…挖掘隧道

ex.en: The train entered a dark tunnel beneath the hill.
ex.zh: 火车驶入了山下的一条漆黑隧道。

ex.en: Building a tunnel under the river could reduce traffic congestion and improve connections between neighbouring districts.
ex.zh: 在河底修建隧道可以缓解交通拥堵，并改善相邻区域之间的交通联系。

tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 4 B。介词 through 常表示从隧道内部穿过。

senses.zh: 摩天楼，超高层大楼；特别高的东西

ex.en: The skyscraper cast a long shadow across the park.
ex.zh: 那座摩天大楼在公园里投下了一道长长的影子。

ex.en: Building skyscrapers can accommodate growing urban populations, but cities must also invest in reliable public transport.
ex.zh: 建造摩天大楼可以容纳不断增长的城市人口，但城市也必须投资建设可靠的公共交通。

col: build a skyscraper｜建造摩天大楼
glass skyscraper｜玻璃幕墙摩天大楼
tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 4 B。比普通high-rise更强调极高的建筑。

ex.en: We bought identical jackets without knowing about each other's choice.
ex.zh: 我们在不知道对方选择的情况下，买了完全一样的夹克。

ex.en: Providing identical resources to every school may not address differences in students' needs or local circumstances.
ex.zh: 向每所学校提供完全相同的资源，未必能解决学生需求或当地情况的差异。

tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 4 B。常用 identical to；比 similar 的相似程度更强。

ex.en: We found a shady spot beside the river.
ex.zh: 我们在河边找到了一处阴凉的地方。

ex.en: Satellite images help researchers spot changes in forest cover before extensive damage occurs.
ex.zh: 卫星图像帮助研究人员在大面积破坏发生之前发现森林覆盖的变化。

tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 4 B。on the spot可指“当场”或“在现场”，依语境判断。

ex.en: Our lecturer stayed after class to explain the diagram.
ex.zh: 我们的讲师课后留下来讲解那张图。

ex.en: A university lecturer can encourage critical thinking by asking students to compare evidence from different sources.
ex.zh: 大学讲师可以要求学生比较不同来源的证据，从而培养批判性思维。

tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 4 B。某学科的讲师用lecturer in；不等同于教授。

senses.zh: 冬泳者；极地熊；北极熊篇

tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 4 B

ex.en: Please turn off the tap while brushing your teeth.
ex.zh: 刷牙时请关上水龙头。

ex.en: Universities can tap local expertise to develop practical solutions to environmental problems affecting nearby communities.
ex.zh: 大学可以利用当地的专业知识，为影响周边社区的环境问题制定切实可行的解决方案。

col: turn off the tap｜关上水龙头
tap someone on the shoulder｜轻拍某人的肩膀
tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 4 B。水龙头在美式英语中常称faucet。

ex.en: The metallic frame makes this chair surprisingly heavy.
ex.zh: 金属框架让这把椅子出乎意料地重。

ex.en: Metallic components can often be recovered from discarded electronics, reducing the need to extract new raw materials.
ex.zh: 废弃电子产品中的金属部件通常可以回收，从而减少开采新原材料的需求。

col: a metallic sound｜金属般的声音
a metallic finish｜金属光泽饰面
tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 4 B。metallic既可指含金属，也可形容像金属的光泽或声音。
📘 选必1 Reading Unit 4 B

ex.en: We recycle glass bottles at the centre near our house.
ex.zh: 我们把玻璃瓶送到家附近的回收中心回收。

ex.en: Cities can reduce landfill waste by making it easier for residents to recycle everyday packaging.
ex.zh: 城市可以通过方便居民回收日常包装来减少填埋垃圾。

col: recycle household waste｜回收生活垃圾
tip: 📘 选必1 Reading Unit 4 B。recycle指回收加工再利用，reuse侧重直接再次使用。
